name: property-tests-on-engine-save
description: Whenever the segmenter, formula engine, or detector changes, run the fast-check property suites and report any shrunk counterexamples before continuing.

then.prompt: Run `npx vitest run` for the FrameSheet engine property tests. If any fast-check property fails, treat the shrunk counterexample as authoritative: identify which invariant in .kiro/specs/framesheet-engine/requirements.md (Acceptance Invariants) is violated, fix the engine (never weaken the property to pass), and re-run until green.
